title: Multi-load distribution with a ceiling
description: A 24V supply feeds a bus through a shared feeder; three loads hang off the bus. Required exactly: 'V1 vin 0 DC 24', 'Rfeed vin bus 2', 'Rl1 l1 0 100', 'Rl2 l2 0 50', 'Rl3 l3 0 50'. Connect the bus to each load node through a resistor of your choice (use 0.01 ohm for a direct wire). Constraints: V(l1) >= 20V, V(l2) >= 20V, V(l3) between 20V and 21V (it is a 21V-max part), and total supply current at most 1.2A (drop across Rfeed at most 2.4V). Return a valid SPICE netlist.
